jobs.title: MEP Engineer
jobs.summary:
Department:Engineering / Construction  
Location: Ain Sokhna Site
Employment Type:** Full-Time  
Experience: 3–5 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced MEP Site Engineer to supervise and coordinate Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) installations on construction sites. The successful candidate will ensure that all MEP works are executed according to approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.

jobs.title: Junior HSE Site Engineer
jobs.summary:
Key Responsibilities : 
• Site Inspections & Audits: Conduct routine safety walks, site inspections, and audits to identify workplace hazards, unsafe acts, and non-conformities.
• Risk Assessments & Permits: Assist in preparing and monitoring Job Safety Analyses (JSA), Method Statements & Risk Assessments (MSRA), and Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems.
• Training & Inductions: Deliver safety induction training for new personnel, subcontractors, and site visitors, and participate in Toolbox Talks (TBT).
• Incident Reporting: Support incident, accident, and near-miss investigations, helping collect data for Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and tracking corrective action plans.
• PPE & Critical Operations: Monitor daily compliance with Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) guidelines and high-risk activities like working at heights, lifting operations, or excavation.
• Documentation & Metrics: Maintain site HSE logs, inspection records, safety statistics, and assist in drafting weekly and monthly management reports

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.summary:
The Accountant is responsible for controlled financial processing and reconciliations within Finance & Cost Control. The role delivers reliable outcomes through disciplined coordination, accurate records and adherence to agreed technical, service or operating standards.

Core responsibilities:
1. Validate transactions, supporting approvals and ledger entries before posting.
2. Reconcile allocated accounts and resolve posting differences on schedule.
3. Verify financial transactions and supporting documents against approved accounting procedures.
4. Reconcile financial data, monitor exceptions and prepare management information on time.
5. Coordinate technical or operational interfaces, document decisions and close assigned issues on schedule.
6. Maintain reliable records and verify outputs against approved requirements before handover.

jobs.title: Data Specialist
jobs.summary: We are seeking a Data Specialist to support data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting. The role involves maintaining accurate records, preparing reports, identifying trends, and supporting data-driven business decisions. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, proficiency in Excel, and experience working with databases and reporting tools. Good communication and problem-solving skills are essential.
